reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the concept of L12 precipitate strengthening (from eutectic FCC/B2 HEAs in P5, P17) with the dynamic deformation challenges of BCC refractory HEAs (adiabatic softening and limited strain hardening from P1, P15) and proposes a specific, non-obvious intervention (aging to form coherent L12 precipitates in a single-phase BCC HfZrTiTa0.53 alloy) to overcome a known limitation. No passage studies this specific alloy, this specific precipitate type in a BCC refractory matrix, or this combination of mechanisms under dynamic loading.
